subject: Television & Streaming
title: Shonda Rhimes and the Shondaland Empire
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Shonda Rhimes and the Shondaland Empire.

hook.text: Shonda Rhimes owned Thursday nights on ABC. Grey's Anatomy, Scandal, and How to Get Away with Murder aired back to back.

buildup.text: Rhimes built diverse casts as a default, not a statement. She didn't explain it—she just did it.

discovery.text: Her shows mastered the cliffhanger. Every episode ended with a gasp moment that made viewers return the next week.

twist.text: Netflix paid Rhimes $300 million to leave ABC. She became the first showrunner to be valued like a tech executive.

climax.text: Rhimes proved that diversity isn't a compromise—it's a competitive advantage.

punchline.text: She made diversity look obvious because it always was.

quiz.question: How much did Netflix reportedly pay Shonda Rhimes to leave ABC?
